name: STROMER 4

real.trim: Pro Performance / 1st Edition (77 kWh, rear motor)

specs.notes: 150 kW (204 PS, 201 hp) and 310 N m from the rear motor, 0-100 km/h in 8.5 s, 160 km/h limited, 2,049 kg DIN (2,124 kg EU with a driver), 2,771 mm wheelbase (VW newsroom, zeperfs). The motor's curve is modelled as constant torque to ~4,600 rpm then constant power to 16,000; one gear (13:1, 160 km/h at the limiter); regenerative braking when you lift (55 N m at the motor), a motor-and-inverter whine for the sound.

garage.blurb: A heavy electric crossover: all its torque the instant you touch the pedal, one gear, a whine instead of a roar, and it slows itself when you lift.

interior.notes: The model's own cabin (seats, dash, centre screen, steering wheel); the steering wheel is cut out to turn.

limitations: The motor's torque curve, the regen strength, weight distribution and drag area are estimates.
No gear lever: the ID.4 has a drive selector on the instrument pod (the hand stays on the wheel).
A game-rip cabin: simple shapes in one black palette (lifted to dark grey so it reads); VW badges remain in its texture.
No live gauges yet (data/dash): its own static display, the dome light.
